title: rest/i18n: GET /i18n/translations/:locale serves the whole locale bundle (288–361 KB raw, 80–88 KB compressed) on every console open with no ETag or Cache-Control, and carries Studio's metadataForms (46.8 KB) into the boot read
body:
Filing gate: ① a measured defect (bytes and latency on the console open path), found by cloud#2914 round 10 (report: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/2914#issuecomment-6396581531). Platform-first: the endpoint and the bundle are the framework's.

Session: `session_01FSg7JRUiTPo8GrgT38tAWP` · seat `repo:cloud#1`

**Business reason.** On staging, the translations call is the slowest leg of the console open's third wave: it took 1128 → 3091 ms in the ops seat's reading (https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/2914#issuecomment-6392341684). Every open re-downloads the full locale bundle, and nothing lets the browser revalidate it.

**Reader who acts.** A framework dev for the `/i18n/translations` route and the boot bundle's composition.

## Measured (cloud `main` `36b07fdf`, framework pin `888d6865`, zh-CN)

| plane | raw | gzip | brotli | headers |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| tenant (HotCRM 5.0.0) | 287,895 B | 87,940 | 86,272 | no ETag, no Cache-Control (`Vary: Origin`) |
| control plane | 361,190 B | 80,551 | 79,448 | no ETag, no Cache-Control |

- The CPU cost is small (12–14 ms). The cost is bytes and re-download on every open.
- **Composition (tenant):**
  - `objects` 109.7 KB raw: every object, not the page's;
  - `metadataForms` 46.8 KB: Studio's metadata forms, which no console boot reads;
  - `settings` 17.2 KB;
  - `dashboards` 5.5 KB;
  - `apps` 4.9 KB.
- On the control plane, cloud's own `sys_environment` and `sys_package` are 76.6 KB of the bundle.

## Fix sketch

1. Serve an `ETag` with `Cache-Control: private, no-cache`, so warm opens answer 304.
2. Keep `metadataForms` out of the boot bundle and load it with Studio.

Optional: scope `objects` to what the current app needs. That is a bigger contract change; say so if it is taken.

## Acceptance

- A warm second open of the same locale gets 304 for `/i18n/translations/<locale>`.
- The boot bundle no longer carries `metadataForms`.
- Studio still renders its forms translated.

Expected saving: 80–88 KB per warm open, about 0.2–0.27 s on the ops seat's measured link (326–464 KB/s).

## Dedupe

`search_issues` for 'i18n translations endpoint ETag cache whole locale bundle every console open metadataForms' returned 24 hits, all closed and all about missing keys or wrong leaves. None covers caching or composition.

## 维护者速读

每次打开控制台都会整包重新下载当前语言的翻译（约 80–88 KB 压缩后），没有 ETag/缓存头，浏览器无法用 304 复用；包里还带着只有 Studio 才用的 metadataForms（46.8 KB）。staging 上这一项是第 3 波里最慢的请求（约 2 秒）。修复：加 ETag + `no-cache`，并把 metadataForms 移出启动包。
